# sonarqube_qualityprofiles (Data Source)

Lists quality profiles, sorted by language and name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sonarqube_qualityprofiles" "java" {
  language = "java"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `language` (String) Only return profiles of this language.
- `name` (String) Only return profiles with this exact name.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier of this lookup in Terraform state.
- `quality_profiles` (Attributes List) Matching profiles. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--quality_profiles))

<a id="nestedatt--quality_profiles"></a>
### Nested Schema for `quality_profiles`

Read-Only:

- `active_rule_count` (Number) Number of rules active in the profile, inherited ones included.
- `id` (String) Profile key.
- `is_built_in` (Boolean) Whether this profile ships with SonarQube and cannot be changed.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this is the default profile for its language.
- `key` (String) Profile key.
- `language` (String) Language key.
- `name` (String) Profile name.
- `parent` (String) Name of the parent profile, or null.
